استعرن (form X)
# اِسْتَعَرْنَ (istaʕarna) /is.ta.ʕar.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِسْتَعَارَ (istaʕāra)
# اُسْتُعِرْنَ (ustuʕirna) /us.tu.ʕir.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِسْتَعَارَ (istaʕāra)
# اِسْتَعِرْنَ (istaʕirna) /is.ta.ʕir.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَعَارَ (istaʕāra)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
